title: 冬の花と実
subject_en: Winter flowers, berries and branches, each a separate small botanical item with coloured petals (red, pink, yellow, orange, green leaves) and clear dark-navy outlines. Avoid all-white flowers. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: つばき、すいせん、シクラメン、ポインセチア、なんてん。冬を彩る花と実のイラスト12点。冬のおたよりやカードに。
items: a red camellia flower with glossy green leaves
yellow and cream daffodils with long green leaves
a pink cyclamen plant with heart-shaped leaves
a red poinsettia with green leaves
a branch of red nandina berries with green leaves
a pink sasanqua camellia branch with leaves
a branch of pink plum blossoms and buds
a sprig of holly with red berries
a branch with a cluster of orange-red berries and dark green leaves
three purple and yellow pansies in a small group
a small branch with several orange kumquats and leaves
a small terracotta pot with a mix of colourful winter flowers
